label: The attenuation constant
subgoals: Check that R prime and G prime are small against the reactive terms
Add R prime over two Z0 and G prime Z0 over two
Multiply by length and by 8.686 to get decibels

label: Nepers and decibels
subgoals: Multiply the attenuation constant by the length in nepers
Scale the input amplitude by e to the minus that loss
Convert nepers to decibels with the factor 8.686

label: Scaling loss with frequency
subgoals: Scale the conductor loss by the square root of the frequency ratio
Scale the dielectric loss linearly with the frequency ratio
Add the two scaled parts for the total loss
